freshResearch.method: First-party web discovery followed by TLS-verified bounded GETs and source HTML inspection; no credentials, private tokens, login, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe fields, or global TLS disablement used.

portalsFound.observation: Official Tonghua Natural Resources Bureau site exposes the local bureau and a dedicated real-estate registration center section; no parcel feature service was exposed on the loaded homepage.

Official institutional page states that the bureau performs unified natural-resource and real-estate rights registration, cadastral investigation, real-estate surveying and mapping, and establishes a citywide registration information-management platform. This establishes local institutional custody, not open vector access.

Official registration-center publication describes controlled access to registration records and digital query infrastructure; it requires qualifying identity/interest and does not expose an anonymous parcel geometry API.

Official Jilin government report states Tonghua registration services operate in the city government service hall and use the provincial natural-resources one-window platform for registration, tax, archive, and electronic-certificate queries. It does not provide public parcel vector data.
